input.quote: The term of this Agreement (the "Term") will commence on the Effective Date and will expire upon the earliest of (i) termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 14.2, or (ii) the date of payment of the last Approval Payment due based on all applicable Regulatory Approvals which have been received.
input.rationale: Section 14.1 is the only term provision, and it sets a finite, event-based term: the Agreement expires on the earlier of termination under Section 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment. Targeted searches for "renew", "automatically renew", "extension of the Term", "then-current term", and CPI/price-increase language returned no renewal mechanic anywhere in the document and no renewal uplift provision. There is therefore no automatic renewal, no non-renewal notice window to compute, and no renewal price escalation; the conditional automatic-renewal and uplift elements are not engaged, and any extension of this Term would require a mutually signed amendment. That is at or above the preferred position (renewal only by mutual written agreement), so no redline is warranted — inserting an auto-renewal construct would only create exit friction that does not bind us today.
